description: Add observed 422 Validation Error responses missing from the Vultr OpenAPI spec. Discovered via live API probing — all /databases/{databaseId}/* endpoints return 422 (often with a {message: string} body instead of the documented {error, status} shape) when given an invalid Database Subscription UUID. POST /cdns/pull-zones also returns 422 for invalid origin_domain values.
